The descendant operations are independently reconstructed and collapse to coefficients d and d^2 on the solution locus. The packaged checker verifies the Hom-Lie-Yamaguti axioms symbolically and exhaustively replays representative finite-field cases.

value.rationale: The exceptional parameter is structurally forced by the Hom twist rather than chosen arbitrarily: alpha becomes singular and alpha^s kills the active u1 direction exactly for k=0 and positive s. This doubles the dimension of the operator variety from one to two while leaving the descendant algebra controlled by a single parameter, cleanly separating operator moduli from deformation type. The source example is the paper’s concrete two-dimensional test case, so completing its phase diagram provides a natural benchmark.
